name: Butterfly Button — Discreet Help at a Click
author: butterflybutton

sections.description:
The Butterfly Button is a digital safe zone that secretly provides information, assistance and contacts domestic violence victims with experts who will be happy to assist. By adding it to your website, you help to hide the usage of The Butterfly, no one can trace the actions made inside The Butterfly and no entry is saved in the browsing history.

With a few finger taps, without leaving traces, everybody can get help, consult and read info about domestic violence.

Key Features:

  • Complete Privacy: No browsing history is saved, ensuring user safety
  • Discreet Access: Provides help without leaving digital traces
  • Expert Contacts: Connects users with domestic violence specialists
  • Information Resources: Offers comprehensive information about domestic violence
  • Easy Integration: Simple to add to any WordPress website
  • Safe Zone: Creates a secure digital environment for vulnerable individuals

Who This Helps:

This plugin is designed for websites that want to provide a safe, discreet way for domestic violence victims to access help and information. It’s particularly valuable for:

  • Community organizations
  • Healthcare providers
  • Government websites
  • Educational institutions
  • Any website committed to supporting domestic violence victims

Developed by CAVO – Connecting for a safer world.

Support

For support and more information about the Butterfly Button project, please visit:

  • Plugin Website: https://butterfly-button.com
  • Organization: CAVO – Connecting for a safer world

External services

This plugin connects to the Butterfly Button external service to enable confidential consultation with domestic violence experts.

What the service is and what it is used for:
The Butterfly Button SDK provides a discreet interface that allows website visitors to consult with domestic violence experts around the world. The SDK is loaded from https://butterfly-button.web.app/cdn/butterfly-plugin.js and is required to display the consultation interface when users click the Butterfly Button.

What data is sent and when:
* The plugin loads the Butterfly Button SDK JavaScript file on pages where the button is displayed
* When a user clicks the Butterfly Button, your configured API key is sent to authenticate and display the expert consultation interface
* The SDK handles all user interactions within the consultation interface according to the Butterfly Button service’s privacy practices

Service provider information:
* Service Provider: CAVO – Connecting for a safer world
* Service Website: https://butterfly-button.com
* Developer SDK License Agreement: https://www.butterfly-button.com/en/cavo-software-developer-kit-license-agreement/
* GitHub Documentation: https://github.com/TheButterflyButton/About

Privacy & Security

This plugin is designed with privacy as the top priority. The Butterfly Button:

  • Does not store any user interaction data
  • Does not save browsing history
  • Provides completely anonymous access to help resources
  • Uses secure connections for all communications
  • Protects user identity at all times

Contributing

The Butterfly Button is part of a mission to create a safer world. If you’d like to contribute to this important cause, please visit our website for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the butterfly-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Butterfly Button settings page in your WordPress admin
  4. Configure the plugin settings according to your needs
  5. The Butterfly Button will now be available on your website

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin files
  2. Upload the entire butterfly-button directory to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin interface
sections.faq:
Is the Butterfly Button completely anonymous?

Yes, the Butterfly Button is designed with complete privacy in mind. No browsing history is saved, and no traces are left on the user’s device when accessing help through the button.

How does the button appear on my website?

The Butterfly Button integrates seamlessly into your website and can be configured through the plugin settings. It provides a discreet way for visitors to access help without drawing attention.

Who can I contact for support with domestic violence?

The Butterfly Button connects users with domestic violence experts and specialists who are trained to provide appropriate assistance and support.

Can this plugin be customized?

Yes, the plugin includes settings that allow you to customize how the Butterfly Button appears and functions on your website.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the Butterfly Button plugin is free to use as part of CAVO’s mission to create a safer world.
